attributes.action: Rivers and ponds need to be fenced off to stop children from falling in
attributes.additional_details: Recently we have lost so many young children to large bodies of water like ponds and lakes that need to be fenced off. We need to raise more awareness for SEN children so they can be safe in the community. Something needs to change so that no more children loose their lives and families dont need to go through the pain and guilt of loosing their child to something that can be preventable
attributes.background: Too many children are loosing their lives to falling in ponds and rivers, this is especially the case with SEN children all ponds and rivers that the public can access need to have fences around them to stop this from happening. We need to protect children and those with SEN needs

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Place safety measures around dangerous open water
